reason: I already have a routine with Toplux and reorder it when it runs out, plus a drawer full of half-used bottles. I don't need another supplement to try, and this costs more than what I already take.
objection: $29.99 is more than Toplux ($23) or Goli ($19), and I already have something I trust and reorder. Made in China also makes me hesitate, even with a lab report.
would_change_my_mind: A price around $19 for the 30 days, or a free trial box so I could see if it beats what I take now.
